supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Final FY2024 CMS-64 rows total $22,040,893,774 for North Carolina's federal Medicaid share. CMS does not publicly release category-of-service quarters, so any annual row still above $10B is an explicit public disclosure ceiling rather than an invented split. Medicaid is a major component of public welfare, but this federal-share boundary is supplemental—not additive—to the broader Census state-government function.
